finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_interquantile_envelope_occupancy_20d
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The fixed Alpha158 definitions expose the central 60-percent close-price range through QTLU20-QTLD20 and the full high-low envelope through MAX20-MIN20. Their ratio measures how broadly ordinary closes occupy the available monthly envelope rather than whether that envelope was created by a few isolated extremes. This is an own-stock price-distribution-shape mechanism with no BETA/RSQR trend-linearity weight, volume confirmation, peer rank, cross-horizon geometry, fitted model or return-selected parameter.

parameters.valid_input_rule: all four inputs finite; MAX20-MIN20 strictly positive; QTLU20-QTLD20 nonnegative and no larger than MAX20-MIN20 within 1e-6 numerical tolerance; never fill, clip or add epsilon
parameters.economic_hypothesis: higher central occupancy represents sustained traversal of the monthly price envelope and less dependence on isolated extreme prints, which may preserve near-term price discovery better over a three-session holding horizon

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_interquantile_envelope_compression_20d
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: One minus the selected occupancy score, or the raw inverse direction, is a deterministic inversion and would turn Campaign297 into a two-direction search.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_interquantile_envelope_occupancy_horizon_grid
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Trying 5, 10, 30 or 60 sessions, averaging horizons or selecting the best horizon would create a postulated horizon search. One conventional 20-session month is frozen before values.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_alternate_quantile_band_or_tail_occupancy_grid
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Alpha158 freezes only the 20th and 80th close quantiles. Inventing alternate quantiles, tail weights, IQR powers, logit transforms or clipped ratios would create an avoidable transform family.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_raw_interquantile_width_or_full_range
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Either raw width retains price-scale and volatility exposure instead of testing distribution occupancy; each is also directly represented by existing Alpha158 inputs rather than the selected normalized shape mechanism.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_close_only_envelope_or_current_price_position_variant
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Replacing the frozen high-low envelope with close extrema, adding the current close location, or conditioning on RANK/RSV would change the mechanism and introduce additional component and weighting choices.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: campaign295_or_campaign296_retune_reverse_rehorizon_threshold_reweight_or_combination
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign295 and Campaign296 are immutable and terminal. Their SUMD20/CORD20 and BETA10/RSQR10 definitions may not be inverted, re-horizoned, thresholded, reweighted, combined or otherwise rescued. The selected factor uses none of those inputs.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_peer_rank_state_consensus_extremity_persistence_or_horizon_geometry_refresh
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign290--294 already consumed that mechanism cluster. Campaign297 uses raw within-stock rolling distribution geometry and no same-session peer transform.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_supervised_tree_mlp_kernel_hash_weight_or_subset_search
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign286--289 and earlier complete-library campaigns already consumed fitted and randomized model families. Campaign297 contains exactly one deterministic weight-1 factor and no training-return read.
